verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents a console, a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, an SDK and a conventional CLI. None of these is a first-party natural-language command interface, and machine-readable docs such as llms.txt or the OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
